role: An IIcon wrapper that flips a base icon's U coordinate (and nominally V) when queried; BlockDoor builds flipped variants of its door textures for the inner faces.
scope_reason: BlockDoor.getIcon returns IconFlipped icons, so the door's rendered UVs depend on this class; the native door mesher reproduces the swap.

members.name: baseIcon
members.note: the C door mesher reads the unflipped lower-door icon and swaps U itself

members.name: flipU
members.note: the flipU=true case (BlockDoor's second icon) is mirrored by swapping min/max u

members.name: flipV
members.note: no vanilla user passes flipV=true, and the C mesher has no V-flip path; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: getIconWidth
members.note: delegates to the base icon; the C engine reads the icon size from atlas.json

members.name: getMinU
members.note: the swap is applied when the mesher writes the door's UVs

members.name: getInterpolatedU
members.note: the door mesher writes corner UVs directly

members.name: getMinV
members.note: flipV is never true in vanilla (getMinV returns base.getMinV() in both branches)

notes: BlockDoor.java:107-108 is the only IconFlipped construction in oracle/src. Evidence is indirect: persist-village-s42 contains village houses with doors exercising the door mesher generally, and no render scene isolates the flipped inner face, so the pixel-exactness of the swap was not verified in isolation. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): vanilla never builds a V-flipped icon. Formerly listed as missing: The V flip (flipV) has no native path; vanilla never constructs one, so no behavior is lost today, but any future IconFlipped(base, false, true) user would render wrong. lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records persist-village-full-s42, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
